close_reason: Done on claude/alert-collector: apps/monitor-alerts (Fastify), WalletAlertState table, pure decide() with 14 passing checks, publishes AlertEvent on alerts.telegram.
description: Consumes the wallet-state event, loads the alert settings of every owner of that wallet, and decides who hears about what. Alerts on transition only: in-range to out-of-range and back, health factor crossing the owner's threshold. Keeps its own last-known state per owner+position so a position sitting out of range does not alert every cycle, carries state over for a source that failed, and publishes before it persists. Publishes notification events; does not format them.
title: Alert collector: per-user settings, transitions, fan-out
